_comment: Spirits integrator E3 (2026-11-13): a HUMAN commit of an offered plan realises it the way the autonomous executor does. Board Azorius Chancery ({W}{U}) + Unclaimed Territory x2 ({C} for a noncreature spell); hand Godless Shrine + Lingering Souls. The offered line `land=Godless Shrine; cast: Lingering Souls, Lingering Souls (flashback)` pays {2}{W} with Chancery + a Territory and the flashback's {1}{B} with the Shrine + the other Territory. Before the fix the human commit (MTG_LINE_SPARE_GENERIC_FIRST was autonomous-only) paid the hand Souls' generic with the Shrine, stranded the {B} and dropped the flashback: two tokens, opponent 4 survives T6, win T7. Autonomous play of the same board won T6. Now four 1/1 fliers swing T6 for exactly 4.
